correctness.rationale: Every constant-free strong-Kleene term is monotone in the flat information order and sends all-u to u. If two term values disagree below and above an intermediate tuple, monotonicity precludes either agreeing at the intermediate tuple, hence disagreement loci are order convex and omit all-u. Conversely for convex D excluding all-u, the upsets U=up(D) and V=U\D permit disjunctions A,B of nonempty literal conjunctions (with B=A∧¬A when V is empty). The pair A∨¬A and B∨¬A disagrees precisely on D, by checking U\V, V and the complement of U. The infectious conditional is explicitly term-definable. Upsets of every cardinality among 3^k-1 noncentral valuations give the exact agreement probabilities j/3^k. A new full closure of two-variable terms gave 82 functions and all 256 punctured subsets; an independent bitmask interval exhaustive census of 2^26 three-variable candidates with 24 constraints gave precisely 3,886,222. Full-arity theorem is constructive, not inferred from finite tests.
